  -- Thought: Determined that while Northumbrian is the dialect of the northern Anglian kingdom (Northumbria), the specific location "Humber estuary" falls under the jurisdiction of the Mercian kingdom (Lindsey). Decided to use WebSurfer to verify this geographical and linguistic boundary.

- Agent: WebSurfer

  -- Thought: Interpreted the search results to conclude that the area "in the Humber estuary" (specifically the south/east bank or Lindsey) belongs to the Mercian dialect zone, not the Northumbrian zone.
  -- Result: Provided evidence supporting the conclusion that the dialect was Mercian, leading the Planner to finalize the answer.
